# Enoch

> Tamper-evident records for regulated enterprises.

Enoch is a tamper-evident event logging and documentation archiving product for
regulated professional firms (law firms, medical practices, accountants),
built by The Good Code Company of Toronto.

## How it works

- Customer events and documents stay private in customer-controlled systems.
- Cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) and trusted timestamps are anchored to the
  Hedera public network via the Hedera Consensus Service.
- Verification needs only the original record and a public Hedera mirror
  node. No Enoch software, account, or permission is required.

## Status

Enoch is in development and has not launched. It has no customers,
certifications, security audits, or court acceptance yet. Pricing is not
finalized.
